plotEn:
Niki White is the apprentice of New York City piano tuner Harry Horowitz, a friend of his late father who teaches him that the tones are more of a feeling than a sound. Although a gifted musician, Niki has hyperacusis and can no longer play the piano, wearing ear protection at all times against loud noises. After Harry forgets the combination to his safe, Niki teaches himself to open it with his heightened hearing, discovering a talent for safe-cracking.
While tuning at a music conservatory, Niki meets Ruthie, a hyper-competitive student pianist and aspiring composer. Flirting, he impresses her with a display of astonishing auditory acuity and memory recall. Later, Niki is tuning at a wealthy client's home until construction noise becomes too loud. He interrupts a trio drilling into a safe, who claim they are installing a new safe, and asks when they will finish. The trio feel insulted and rudely say an indefinite amount of time until the old safe is opened. Niki breaks into the safe for them to save time, impressing them in the process, and receiving an offer of "real money" from their leader, Uri. The next day at a diner, Harry encourages Niki to walk Ruthie to class, but the interaction fizzles when he suggests her composition is derivative. However, they begin a romance after Niki repairs her treasured piano. Niki tells her that it took years of exposure therapy to manage his sensitivity to sound. When Harry is hospitalized after a heart attack, Niki accepts Uri's offer,
